answer: Require every identity to keep a live pulse: a signed heartbeat proving it completed real paid work in the last epoch, or its trust decays to zero. New identities start on the floor and must climb a flat mesa of verified jobs — reputation only rises after dozens of settled transactions, never by self-assertion. The fable that one agent can fake a thousand reputations dies here: each clone needs its own sustained work history, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times the genuine labor, and idle clones slide off the mesa.
